arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
s=open('planner.py').read()
old_start = s.index("    best = None\n    for y, q in candidates:")
old_end = s.index("    if best is None:\n        return None, None\n    return best[2], best[3]")
new = '''    best = None
    best_key = None
    for y, q in candidates:
        val = float(prob.b.dot(y))
        if K:
            val += float(prob.d.dot(q))
        if not np.isfinite(val) or val <= 0.0:
            continue
        if abs(val - 1.0) > 1e-9:
            y = y / val
            q = q / val
        col = _dense_cols(prob, y, q)
        worst_col = float(np.max(col))
        worst_y = float(np.max(y)) if y.size else 0.0
        err = abs(float(prob.b.dot(y)) +
                  (float(prob.d.dot(q)) if K else 0.0) - 1.0)
        score = max(worst_col, worst_y, err)
        if not np.isfinite(score):
            continue
        mag = float(np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate([y, q])))) \\
            if (y.size + q.size) else 0.0
        # any candidate inside the acceptance envelope is fine; prefer the
        # smallest magnitude, because that is the most rounding robust.
        key = (0, mag) if score <= 1e-8 else (1, score)
        if best_key is None or key < best_key:
            best_key = key
            best = (y, q)
'''
s = s[:old_start] + new + s[old_end:]
# replace the tail selection lines
s = s.replace("""    if best is None:
        return None, None
    return best[2], best[3]""",
"""    if best is None:
        return None, None
    return best[0], best[1]""")
open('planner.py','w').write(s)
PYEOF
